findings.title: No server-side authentication on admin API routes
findings.evidence: POST /api/admin/sources/fetch succeeds without any Authorization header. Code at line 13 goes directly to request.json() with no auth check.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated actors can trigger URL fetches, write extraction candidates, and invoke geocoding API

findings.title: Demo admin toggle bypass not disabled in production
findings.evidence: toggleDemoAdmin() function sets localStorage 'soco_demo_admin'=true and grants isAdmin=true. No NODE_ENV guard.
findings.impact: Developers who leave demo admin enabled in a production-deployed instance gain admin UI access

findings.title: applyAppearanceFilters() reads global memoryVendors/memoryVenues in Firestore mode
findings.evidence: Lines 226, 233, 241, 248 reference memoryVendors and memoryVenues directly. These are not populated in Firestore mode.
findings.impact: City, cuisine, dietary, and search query filters return wrong results in Firestore mode

findings.title: Admin role determination via self-writable Firestore profile
findings.evidence: Line 89: isRoleAdmin = profile.role === 'admin'. Firestore rule allows users to write their own /users/{uid} document including the role field.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can escalate to admin role by writing role:'admin' to their Firestore document

findings.title: Firestore security rules not deployed (no firebase.json)
findings.evidence: No firebase.json or .firebaserc exists in the repository. Rules cannot be deployed without these files.
findings.impact: If Firebase project uses default permissive rules, all data is publicly readable and writable

findings.title: No firestore.indexes.json — compound queries will fail
findings.evidence: fsGetPublicAppearances() uses where('isPublished','==',true), where('status','==','scheduled'), where('date','==',filter.date) — compound query requires index
findings.impact: First production query to /appearances will fail with FAILED_PRECONDITION index error

findings.title: data-map-ready set before tile load event
findings.evidence: Line 52: setMapReady(true) called immediately after Map() constructor. map.on('load',...) fires later. Playwright tests pass because they check data-map-ready, not actual tile rendering.
findings.impact: Tests may pass while map shows blank tiles; flyTo/marker interactions can fail before load

findings.title: Default tile and geocoding providers are rate-limited public services
findings.evidence: mapTileUrl defaults to CARTO free tier; geocodingApiUrl defaults to Nominatim (1 req/s). No production alternatives documented.
findings.impact: Application will hit rate limits under production load

findings.title: Server-side URL fetch has no SSRF protection
findings.evidence: Line 71: fetch(source.url,...) with no URL validation. source.url comes from the database without domain/scheme restrictions.
findings.impact: If API is unauthenticated (P0-001), SSRF risk to internal metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254)

findings.title: Observation ID in candidate.observationIds does not match saved observation
findings.evidence: ai-extractor.ts line 118 generates obsId='obs-${Date.now()}-${i}'. Route handler lines 154-168 generates a different ID for the actually-saved Observation. Provenance link is broken.
findings.impact: candidate.observationIds contains IDs that don't match any saved Observation document

findings.title: Regex HTML parsing is fragile
findings.evidence: Lines 136-141 use regex to strip HTML. Regex HTML parsing fails for malformed HTML, nested tags, and attribute edge cases.
findings.impact: Schedule text may be corrupted before extraction, producing low-quality candidates

findings.title: adminUserId hardcoded as 'admin-user' in audit logs
findings.evidence: Line 46 (sources), line 103 (venues): adminUserId: 'admin-user' literal string passed to addAuditLog()
findings.impact: Audit log cannot be used to attribute actions to specific administrators

findings.title: No content hash deduplication — same content re-extracted every run
findings.evidence: contentHash is computed (line 117) and saved but never compared to previous fetch. Extraction runs on every check regardless of content changes.
findings.impact: Duplicate extraction candidates created for every manual source check

findings.title: Discovery page data load failure is silently swallowed
findings.evidence: Lines 105-108: catch block only logs to console. No error state shown to user.
findings.impact: Firestore permission errors or network failures show '0 results' with no explanation

findings.title: resolveRelativeDayOfWeek uses server UTC day-of-week instead of LA timezone
findings.evidence: Line 160: d.getDay() returns UTC day. Server (cloud) is in UTC, not America/Los_Angeles. Off-by-one on dates crossing midnight boundary.
findings.impact: Schedule extraction assigns wrong date for late-night/early-morning posts near midnight

findings.title: ai-extractor.ts is named and commented as AI/LLM but is heuristic-only regex
findings.evidence: File comment: 'Heuristic & AI text schedule extraction parser'. Implementation: regex patterns only. No LLM API calls present.
findings.impact: Misleads developers about capabilities; extraction quality limited to regex patterns
